rules.expected: Both molecule validation records are present and scientifically defensible, or bounded failure is honestly documented.
A common descriptor/charge definition and explicit atom-indexed alkene assignments support the comparison.
The independent result distinguishes the asymmetric 4 case from the comparatively symmetric 7 case with signed alkene evidence.
The comparison uses calculated atom-resolved reactant charges to evaluate the defined electronic polarization contrast.

The two specified reactant models are compared within the defined aqueous boundary using both (1) a consistently defined MEP/electrostatic-potential descriptor and (2) a clearly stated, scientifically appropriate atom-resolved charge convention at the four mapped alkene carbon sites. MK is an admissible charge partition, not a mandatory one; omitting either requested observable is incomplete.
